observations: The page number «76» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L17 end chapters 26 and 26a (pp. 73-75, JP2 0105-0107). L18-L20 and L26-L28: the headings of chapters 27 and 28-28b, in bold, centred, in two lines each, with the references to the text below them; «26a», «28b», the letters raised.

L01-L06. Checked: the signs equally far from an equinox or a solstice have equal changes of the ascensional difference: Aries, Virgo, Libra and Pisces next to the equinoxes, Taurus, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius, and Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius and Capricorn next to the solstices. The ascensional difference grows from Capricorn to Cancer and shrinks from Cancer to Capricorn, so that for the six signs from Cancer to Sagittarius its change is added to the right ascension of the sign, as L04-L06 say.

L13-L15. Checked: with the shadow of the equinox 12 tg φ (gnomon 12) and the tangent 12 tg δ of the shadow table, (12 tg φ) · (12 tg δ) · 60 : 144 = 60 tg φ tg δ, the sine of the ascensional difference on a radius of 60 (p. 75, JP2 0107, L14-L18); the lost table would have given 12 tg δ · 60 : 144 for every degree. L15: the fraction 60/144 built up, written {fr:60|144}.

L21-L24: the rule of chapter 27 of the text in German quotation marks; «1h», «1m», «1s», the letters raised; 15° of the equator pass in an hour, 15′ in a minute, 15″ in a second. L30: «12p», the p raised and italic. L32: «nach» letter-spaced for emphasis, marked {sp:}.

The dashes: L20 «20—21» (32 px) and L28 «21—22» (35 px), the long dash of the small type of the references; L26 «28—28b», the long dash of the bold heading (47 px); N04 «28–29», the short dash (25 px).
Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Björnbo», «Ḥabash», «Batt.», «nach», «Nallino»; italics: «Ascensio obliqua,», «φ», «differentiarum,», «δ», «Gnomon», the title in N06.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-12 px measured).
